positions.title: Founder & Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building Arete Fitness, a cross-platform mobile fitness platform designed to make workout planning, tracking, and training more flexible and intuitive.
Leading the product from concept through design, architecture, development, testing, and deployment across iOS and Android.
• Built the mobile application with React Native, Expo, and TypeScript.
• Designed and developed workout creation, exercise tracking, workout templates, recovery flows, onboarding, and user profile experiences.
• Built and integrated backend APIs, authentication, CMS architecture, and cloud infrastructure using Next.js, Sanity, Clerk, and Vercel.
• Integrated Apple HealthKit for workout and health data synchronization.
• Implemented application monitoring and error tracking with Sentry.
• Managed iOS development, device testing, production builds, TestFlight distribution, and App Store deployment workflows.
• Developed and tested Android builds across physical devices and Android development environments.
• Built a structured fitness content system containing hundreds of exercises, warm-ups, stretches, and cardio movements.
• Own the full product lifecycle, including product strategy, UX decisions, technical architecture, debugging, QA, performance, and release management.
Technologies: React Native · Expo · TypeScript · Next.js · Sanity · Node.js · Clerk · Zustand · Vercel · Sentry · HealthKit · iOS · Android

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop full stack web and mobile applications using technologies like React.js, Next.js, Flutter, Node.js, Firebase, and AWS—tailored to client needs and performance goals.
- Integrate AI-powered features into SaaS products and websites to automate workflows, enhance user personalization, and drive smarter user experiences. 
- Design and implement user-centered interfaces that merge frontend precision with artistic direction, drawing on a creative background to deliver visual, engaging solutions.
- Customize platforms such as Squarespace, Shopify, and WordPress to meet unique business and design needs.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Build and maintain responsive, cross-platform mobile and web interfaces using Flutter (Dart) and JavaScript, collaborating closely with product and backend teams to ensure seamless integration.
- Implement dynamic UI components and layouts focused on performance, accessibility, and consistent user experience across devices.
- Contribute to frontend architecture by building multi-platform UI components and enhancing design system integration using Flutter and native widget libraries.
- Collaborate closely with designers and backend engineers to integrate APIs, define data structures, and align frontend development with overall product architecture.

positions.title: Actress
positions.description:
Roles in film, television, web series, theatre and commercials.

Performed leading roles in two theater productions at the Brownhouse Theater, North Hollywood, demonstrating exceptional versatility and a strong commitment to live performance art.
Featured in a leading role in a short film directed by filmmaker Donna Wheeler.
